set_title: Đề 12: Xem phim ở rạp + ăn trên đường phố - ăn nhà hàng + nhận một món quà
method: REA captured exam document; question fields only; credentials excluded

questions.stem: In this part, I am going to ask you three short questions about yourself and your interests. You will have 30 seconds to reply to each question.

questions: 1. Please tell me about a famous place in your country?
Tell me about your last holiday
Please tell me about your favorite film.
Tell me a time you laughed a lot.
Do you think people from different countries laugh at different things?

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to compare two pictures, and I will then ask you two questions about them. You will have 45 seconds for each response.
questions.title: Đề 12 - Part 3

questions: Tell me what you see in the two pictures
What are the disadvantages of eating in both places
Why do you think people don't like eating out alone?

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to show you a picture and ask you three questions. You will have one minute to think about your answers before you start speaking. You will have two minutes to answer all three questions.
questions.title: Đề 12 - Part 4

questions: Describe a time you received a gift
2.	How did you feel about this gift?
3. Do you prefer handmade gifts or gifts bought in stores?
